Citi Research has added a 90-day catalyst watch to Wingstop
in anticipation of a “high-frequency data inflection” as near-term sales are likely to react to shifts in the company’s market strategy.
Citi analyst Jon Tower sees Wingstop
will shift its NFL season marketing strategy to feature more promotions to drive traffic.

“We rate WING a Buy and see an improving comp story backing a solid long-term unit growth story in the early innings with strong box economics and high visibility into the compounding of new store growth,” Tower writes in his note to clients, adding that the restaurant chain should see persistent and improving top-line growth.
shares are more than 2% higher in Thursday’s premarket trading.

title: Citi adds upside 90-day catalyst watch as Wingstop's NFL promos to drive traffic
